nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Wraps the CHED reference and version inside the H1 before the static "Decision" title.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Uses a custom caption-within-heading class instead of a standard GOV.UK caption.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use govuk-caption-xl as a caption associated with govuk-heading-xl.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Adds content-specific hook classes to the overall decision form group and the nested radio items/fieldsets for conditional styling or JavaScript.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Couples presentation and reveal behaviour to domain-specific class names. The notAcceptAction items are direct children of a fieldset and omit a govuk-radios container entirely.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use the documented govuk-radios conditional reveal markup, with stable data attributes only where application behaviour needs them.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 206 and trace 189085ad930266a48c024dc1d447e1c2055d6fe9 action 197 (all classes present in main; raw DOM shows refusal .govuk-radios__item elements without a .govuk-radios parent)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Adds bespoke white information-panel styling to the Not acceptable conditional reveal and its nested Destruction/Other Reason reveals.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom styling is layered onto govuk-radios__conditional and is not a GOV.UK Design System modifier.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use the standard govuk-radios conditional reveal without the custom background; use Inset text only if the revealed content genuinely needs additional visual separation.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 206 and trace 189085ad930266a48c024dc1d447e1c2055d6fe9 action 197 (class on #refusal, #not-acceptable-destruction-reason and #not-acceptable-other-reason)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: form-control supplies legacy styling to the two refusal Reason inputs; form-date wraps the standard date input.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Legacy/custom form classes overlap with govuk-input, govuk-!-width-one-half and govuk-date-input already present on the same controls.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use govuk-input with GOV.UK width modifiers and govuk-date-input without the legacy wrappers.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 206 (raw DOM: both Reason inputs have form-control + govuk-input + govuk-!-width-one-half; date wrapper has form-date + govuk-date-input)

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: date-input-day / date-input-month / date-input-year / date-picker-day / date-picker-month / date-picker-year / defra-datepicker / date-picker__container / date-picker__container--icon / date-picker__dialog / date-picker__dialog--hidden / date-picker__header / date-picker__heading / date-picker__date-table / date-picker__reveal__icon / date-picker__button__previous-month / date-picker__button__next-month / date-picker__button__close / aria-live-message / sr-only
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Implements a custom calendar dialog over the standard Day/Month/Year fields, including reveal, month navigation, date table, close control and screen-reader live region.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: The GOV.UK Design System has no date-picker component. This custom interaction needs separate keyboard, focus, announcement and date-selection testing.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use the standard GOV.UK Date input alone. If a calendar is retained it remains a custom accessible component; govuk-visually-hidden can replace sr-only.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 189085ad930266a48c024dc1d447e1c2055d6fe9 action 197 (all classes present in main; structure exposes Choose date, Previous month, July 2026, Next month, SuMoTuWeThFrSa and Cancel)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Visually hides the Channelled "Choose from:" text; it appears alongside govuk-visually-hidden.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Duplicates a standard GOV.UK visually-hidden utility with a local class.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Positions the standard Back link alongside the application's breadcrumb/navigation area outside main.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Custom layout modifier ties the Back link to a combined navigation treatment rather than one clear GOV.UK navigation pattern.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use a standard GOV.UK Back link or Breadcrumbs according to the hierarchy.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 189085ad930266a48c024dc1d447e1c2055d6fe9 action 197 (a#back-link has classes govuk-back-link back-link--next-to-breadcrumbs)
